convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud custom indicator and relies on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (open/close logic), making both signal generation and order management dependent on external code that must be manually replicated.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA trades

other_exits: Historical scan for close signals: when both buy and sell open/close are enabled and no direct close signal from current bar, the EA scans backward from SignalBar+1 through all bars to find the most recent opposite signal in indicator buffers 4/5 to trigger close of the opposing position

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When MMMode=LOT, MM is treated as fixed lot size; otherwise MM represents a share (fraction) of financial resources per MarginMode enum (free margin, balance, loss share of free margin, or loss share of balance)

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a two-phase close signal detection: (1) current bar signal from indicator buffers 4 (up) and 5 (down) at SignalBar offset, and (2) when both buy and sell open/close permissions are enabled but no close signal was found on the current bar, it performs a backward scan through historical bars starting from SignalBar+1 to find the last opposite-direction signal for position closing. Signal timestamps are calculated as SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec, used by the trading functions for pending-like timing. The Recount flag ensures re-reading of indicator data if CopyBuffer fails. Input booleans BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose act as directional trade permission gates.
python_conversion_notes: The custom MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud indicator must be fully reimplemented in Python (it uses 6 buffers, EA reads buffers 4 and 5 for up/down signals). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, LoadHistory, GlobalVariableDel_ and CIsNewBar - all must be reimplemented. The conditional money management (MM + MMMode) with 5 modes needs careful mapping. The backward historical scan for close signals (lines 135-161) is an unusual pattern that must be faithfully reproduced. SL/TP are in raw points (not pips), so no 5-digit adjustment is applied at the EA level - the point values are passed directly to TradeAlgorithms which handles execution. Signal timestamps use SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + PeriodSeconds for trade timing.
